title: Kenworth W900 SAR Legend 2022 FUPS Road Train Bullbar #93
description: Kenworth Legend W900 2022 SAR Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS compliant Bullbar. 125 Diameter cow catcher pipe to be legal for FUPS. 88mm diameter one piece main cross pipes passing through drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds, 100mm diameter pipe available as option. "I" Beam uprights to copy old style Bullbars. Reversible Road Train signs on the main channel. Steel backing plate backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bar sits 270mm from front of Bullbar to mounting point on the truck. Bullbar can be custom built to your requirements.
